messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: { "description": "The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-shaped animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its head, neck, chest, underbelly, tail and paws are covered in dense brown fur, while its back, sides, shoulders, hips and most of its legs are covered by a glossy, dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton that looks like beetle armor. It has a single long, smooth, curved black horn arising from the forehead and arching forward over the head, small rounded furry ears, four stout clawed paws on the ground, and a short bushy furry tail protruding from under the rear armor. The underbelly is pale tan with rows of small circular openings along the side.", "parts": [ { "part": "head", "looks_like": "bear-like, with brown fur, a lighter tan muzzle, a black nose at the front, small dark brown eyes on the sides, and whiskers near the snout", "where": "at the front right end of the body, facing right" }, { "part": "horns", "looks_like": "one long, glossy black, smooth, sickle-shaped horn with a small pointed tooth on its underside near the middle, tapering to a sharp tip", "where": "arising from the center of the forehead between the ears and curving up and forward over the head" }, { "part": "ears", "looks_like": "two small, rounded, brown furry ears with slightly darker edges", "where": "on the top sides of the head, behind the base of the horn" }, { "part": "mane", "looks_like": "thick, shaggy brown fur, longer and denser than the fur on the face", "where": "around the neck, throat and chest, surrounding the base of the head and the front edge of the shoulder armor" }, { "part": "legs", "looks_like": "four thick, stout legs covered in glossy dark segmented armor; the front pair has spiky, saw-toothed edges on the lower segments, the hind pair has smoother rounded segments; brown fur is visible at the joints and near the paws", "where": "under the body, two front legs under the chest/shoulder and two hind legs under the hips, supporting the body on the ground" }, { "part": "feet", "looks_like": "four broad paws with brown fur on top and long, curved dark claws at the tips", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs, in contact with the ground" }, { "part": "tail", "looks_like": "short, bushy, brown furry tail", "where": "at the rear left end of the body, protruding from under the rear dorsal plates" }, { "part": "shell", "looks_like": "large, smooth, domed, glossy dark brown to black plates with visible scratches and highlights", "where": "covering the shoulders and hips on the upper sides of the body, overlapping the dorsal segments" }, { "part": "plates", "looks_like": "numerous overlapping, transverse, glossy dark segmented plates forming an exoskeleton; the pale holed surface is on the lower side of the torso between the dorsal plates and the belly" }, { "part": "markings", "looks_like": "pale tan to cream underbelly contrasting with the dark armor, with two longitudinal rows of small round openings along the side", "where": "on the ventral and lower lateral torso, visible between the dark dorsal armor and the legs" } ], "attached_objects": [], "animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "separate_bodies": 1, "heads": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0, "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "tails": 1 }
